// ── Swarnix SOP source content ───────────────────────────────────────────
// Single source of truth for the "Ask Swarnix" knowledge base. Each entry
// corresponds 1:1 to one "## heading" SOP in SOPs_Swarnix.md. To update the
// knowledge base: edit the `body` text here and re-run this workflow — it
// upserts by slug, so re-running is always safe.
//
// NOTE: keep this array in sync with /SOPs_Swarnix.md in the app repo.
//
// IMPORTANT: this node returns ONE n8n ITEM PER SOP (not one item holding an
// array). Every downstream node in this workflow therefore receives all 12
// items and n8n runs each node once per item automatically, pairing inputs
// and outputs by item index. This is what makes per-item credentials (the
// Google Gemini(PaLM) Api credential on the Embed Content node) and Supabase
// upserts work correctly for every SOP — a single Code node looping with
// this.helpers.httpRequest cannot use node-level credentials at all, which
// is why that approach is avoided here.

const SOPS = [
  {
    slug: 'add-edit-product',
    title: 'How to Add or Edit a Product in Swarnix',
    body: `In short: This lets you put a piece of jewellery into your Swarnix catalogue — with photos, weight, price, and who is allowed to see it — so it shows up correctly for your customers on WhatsApp and your website.

Who can do this: Owners, Admins, and team members with Read & Write access. Team members with Read Only access can see the catalogue but won't see the "Add Product" button at all, and the Edit/Delete buttons on each product card are hidden for them too.

Before you start: Have a clear photo of the piece ready (plain background, no model in it — this photo is used for image search when customers search by photo on WhatsApp). Know the gross weight and either a fixed price or the metal/purity details if you want the price to update automatically with the daily gold rate.

Steps:
1. Go to the Inventory tab from the top menu.
2. Tap the gold "Add Product" button (top right of the page).
3. Fill in SKU / Item Code — this is your own item code, must be unique. It gets capitalised automatically.
4. Fill in Item Name, then pick a Category (Ring, Earring, Necklace, Bangle, etc.) — if your item doesn't fit, choose "Other / type your own…" and type it in.
5. Pick Sub-category if relevant (optional), and Metal Purity (required — e.g. 22K Gold, 925 Silver; or type your own).
6. Optionally fill in Collection, Size / Measurement, and pick a Color chip (Yellow Gold, Rose Gold, White Gold, Two-Tone, Silver, or tap "+ Custom" to name your own).
7. If the piece has diamonds or stones, open the Stone & Diamond Details section and fill in what's relevant — Diamond Purity, Color, Weight, Cut, Shape, count, or Stone/Material details. All optional.
8. Enter the Gross Weight (grams) — this is required. Net Metal Weight and Stock Quantity are optional.
9. Set Visible To — this controls which customers can see this product. Choose "All Customers", "VVIP Only", or "VVIP & VIP Only". Default is All Customers.
10. Choose your pricing: either type a fixed Price (₹ ex-GST), or tap "Dynamic Pricing" to have the price auto-calculate and update every day from the live gold/silver rate (you'll need to fill in metal weight and purity for this).
11. Add a Description if you want (craftsmanship notes, certificate numbers, etc.) — optional.
12. If the piece is BIS hallmarked, open Certificates & Compliance and add the HUID (6-character code) and upload the hallmark certificate photo. Add diamond certificate details too if you have them.
13. Scroll to Product Images and upload up to 5 photos — tap "Upload" to pick from your gallery, or "Camera" to take one directly. The first photo (slot 1) is your primary photo — keep it a plain, jewellery-only shot. At least one photo is required.
14. (Optional) Open AI Model Try-On to generate a photo of a model wearing this piece.
15. Tick "Mark as currently in stock" if the item is available to sell right now.
16. (Optional) Open the Variants section if this design comes in other carat or colour options.
17. Tap Save. Your product now appears in the Inventory list.

To edit later: open Inventory, find the product card, tap the pencil/edit icon, change what you need, and save again.

Good to know:
- You need at least one photo, an SKU, item name, category, metal purity, gross weight, and a price (or dynamic pricing metal details) before Swarnix will let you save.
- Each photo can be max 5 MB. You get 5 photo slots per product.
- Your SKU has to be unique — if you reuse one, Swarnix will tell you "SKU already exists — please use a different one."
- Deleting a product is a soft delete — your sales history stays safe, the item just stops showing in your live catalogue. There's no undo from the screen though, so double check before confirming.
- Your plan has a limit on total products and total photo storage. If you hit either limit, Swarnix will show an upgrade message instead of letting you add more.

Common questions:
- Can my customer see this product or not? That depends on what you picked under "Visible To" — All Customers means everyone sees it, VVIP Only means only your VVIP-tier customers see it, and VVIP & VIP Only means both those tiers see it but Regular customers won't.
- Why can't my staff add or edit products? Only team members with Read & Write access (or higher — Admin) can add, edit, or delete. If someone has Read Only access, they can browse the catalogue but the action buttons won't appear for them.
- What's the difference between Stock Quantity and "Mark as currently in stock"? Stock Quantity is just a number you can track for your own count. "Mark as currently in stock" is the actual toggle that controls whether it shows as available to sell.
- Do I have to use dynamic pricing? No — fixed price is the default. Dynamic pricing is only useful if you want the price to auto-update daily with the gold/silver rate instead of you updating it manually.
- What happens if I delete a product by mistake? It's removed from your live catalogue immediately and there's no "Cancel" after confirming, so always read the confirmation message before tapping Delete.

If something goes wrong:
- "SKU already exists" error — change the SKU to something unique; Swarnix checks this automatically as you type.
- Can't save because of a missing field — Swarnix will pop up exactly which field is missing. Fill that in and try again.
- Image won't upload — check the file is under 5 MB and is a real image file (JPEG, PNG, or WebP).`
  },
  {
    slug: 'ai-model-photo',
    title: 'How to Upload Photos and Generate an AI Model Photo for a Product in Swarnix',
    body: `In short: This lets you upload real photos of a piece of jewellery and also generate a realistic photo of a model wearing it, using AI — handy when you don't have a model shoot budget.

Who can do this: Owners, Admins, and team members with Read & Write access (same access level needed to add or edit products, since this lives inside the product form).

Before you start: Have your product open in Add/Edit Product mode, and a clear photo of just the jewellery piece ready (plain background works best). This feature needs the Professional plan or higher.

Steps — uploading regular product photos:
1. While adding or editing a product, scroll to the Product Images section.
2. Tap "Upload" on any of the 5 image slots to pick a photo from your phone or computer, or tap "Camera" to take one right there.
3. Repeat for up to 5 photos. Slot 1 is your Primary photo — make sure it's a plain, jewellery-only shot, since this is the one used when customers search by photo on WhatsApp.
4. Each photo must be under 5 MB.

Steps — generating an AI model photo:
1. In the same product form, open the AI Model Try-On section.
2. Either drag a clear jewellery photo into the box that says "Click or drag jewellery photo here", or tap the "Camera" button to take one.
3. Tap "Generate AI Model".
4. Wait roughly 30–60 seconds — you'll see a spinner saying "Generating…".
5. Once ready, you'll see the generated model photo in a preview box. If you don't like it, tap "Regenerate" to try again.
6. Happy with it? Tap "Add to Images" — this drops the AI photo straight into your product's photo slots. You'll see a small "Added to images" confirmation.
7. Save the product as usual — the AI photo is now part of your product's images.
8. Want to share the photo elsewhere first? Tap "Share" to send it via WhatsApp, Gmail, Instagram, Twitter, or just copy the link.

Good to know:
- AI model generation only works if your plan includes this feature (Professional plan and above).
- There's a monthly limit on how many AI model photos you can generate — if you hit it, Swarnix will show an upgrade message instead of generating more.
- The AI picks the right jewellery type (ring, necklace, earrings, etc.) automatically based on the product's Category, so make sure Category is set correctly before generating.
- The generated photo only becomes part of the product once you tap "Add to Images" — generating it alone doesn't save it.

Common questions:
- Will this replace my real product photos? No — it adds to your existing photo slots, it doesn't remove your real photos.
- Can I generate more than one AI model photo for the same product? Yes, tap "Regenerate" as many times as you like (subject to your monthly limit), and add whichever one you prefer.
- Why is the Generate button greyed out / not working? You've likely hit your plan's monthly AI model limit, or your plan doesn't include this feature.
- Does the AI model photo show the real jewellery or a recreated version? It's AI-generated based on your uploaded photo, so check it carefully before adding it.

If something goes wrong:
- Generation seems stuck or fails — check your internet connection and try again; if it keeps failing, the monthly limit may be reached.
- Photo upload rejected — make sure the file is an actual image (JPEG/PNG/WebP) and under 5 MB.
- Wrong jewellery type detected — double check the product's Category is set correctly.`
  },
  {
    slug: 'product-variants',
    title: 'How to Add Product Variants (Different Colour or Carat) in Swarnix',
    body: `In short: This lets you offer the same jewellery design in multiple carat or colour options — like the same ring in 18K Yellow Gold, 18K Rose Gold, and 14K White Gold — all under one product listing, each with its own photos if you want.

Who can do this: Owners, Admins, and team members with Read & Write access.

Before you start: Have the base product already created (or open it now), and know the different carat/colour combinations you want to offer, along with each one's weight and price (or dynamic pricing details).

Steps:
1. Open the product in Add/Edit Product mode.
2. Scroll down to the Variants section.
3. Tap "Add variant" — a new variant row appears, collapsed into a summary bar.
4. Tap the summary bar to expand it and fill in the details.
5. Pick the Metal Purity / Carat for this variant (e.g. 18K, 22K).
6. Pick a Color chip (Yellow Gold, Rose Gold, White Gold, Two-Tone, Silver) or tap "+ Custom" for your own colour name.
7. (Optional) Upload up to 5 variant-specific photos — tap Upload or use the camera button on each slot. If you skip this, customers will just see the main product's photos for this variant.
8. Fill in any other details that differ for this variant — Diamond Purity, Diamond Color, Diamond Weight, Size, Net Metal Weight, HUID — all optional.
9. Set the Price for this variant (fixed) or switch to Dynamic Pricing and fill in the metal weight/purity breakdown.
10. Tick "Mark as currently in stock" if this specific variant is available right now.
11. Repeat steps 3–10 for each additional variant you want to add.
12. Tap Save on the product — all variants are saved together with the product.

Good to know:
- If you don't upload separate photos for a variant, Swarnix automatically shows your main product photos instead.
- Removing a variant doesn't delete it permanently right away — it's marked inactive in the background, similar to how deleting a product works.
- Each variant can have totally different pricing (fixed or dynamic) from the main product and from other variants.

Common questions:
- Do I need to upload separate photos for every colour variant? No — only if the variant genuinely looks different.
- Can each variant have a different price? Yes, completely independent pricing per variant.
- What if I want to remove a variant later? Open the product, go to Variants, and remove the one you no longer want, then save.
- Is there a limit to how many variants I can add to one product? There's no hard limit — add as many carat/colour combinations as you genuinely sell.

If something goes wrong:
- Variant won't save — make sure required pricing info is filled (either a fixed price or full dynamic pricing details).
- Variant photo missing on storefront — check whether you actually uploaded a photo for that variant; if not, it should fall back to the main product photo automatically.`
  },
  {
    slug: 'product-visibility',
    title: 'How to Set Product Visibility (All Customers / VVIP / VIP & VVIP) in Swarnix',
    body: `In short: This lets you decide which group of customers is allowed to see a particular product — handy for showing your most exclusive pieces only to your top-tier customers.

Who can do this: Owners, Admins, and team members with Read & Write access (this setting lives inside the Add/Edit Product form).

Before you start: Decide which customer tier should see this product. Customer tiers (Regular/VIP/VVIP) are only available as a feature on the Professional plan and above — if your store is on Trial or Starter, every customer is treated the same and this setting won't make a practical difference yet.

Steps:
1. Open the product in Add/Edit Product mode (Inventory tab → tap a product → edit, or while adding a new one).
2. Find the "Visible To" dropdown (it's in the Weights & Stock section).
3. Choose one of three options: All Customers (everyone can see this product, the default), VVIP Only (only customers tagged VVIP can see it), or VVIP & VIP Only (customers tagged VVIP or VIP can see it; Regular customers cannot).
4. Tap Save.

Good to know:
- This is a single choice per product — you can't mix and match beyond these three options.
- The default for every new product is "All Customers".
- This setting only really matters once you've assigned tiers to your customers.

Common questions:
- Can my customer see this product or not? It depends entirely on what tier you assigned them and what visibility you set on the product.
- Can I set visibility for a whole category at once instead of one product at a time? No — visibility is set per product, one at a time.
- What happens to a VVIP-only product if I haven't tagged any customers as VVIP yet? It simply won't be visible to anyone until you assign that tier to at least one customer.
- Does this affect variants too, or just the main product? Visibility is a product-level setting — it isn't a separate field per variant.

If something goes wrong:
- Customer says they can't see a product you think they should — double-check their assigned tier on the Customers page matches the product's Visible To setting.
- Visibility option didn't save — make sure you tapped Save on the product form after changing it.

Note: The admin app stores and lets you set the "Visible To" value per product, but the actual filtering of products by customer tier happens in the WhatsApp/website-facing systems outside this admin app, not in the dashboard itself.`
  },
  {
    slug: 'manage-customers',
    title: 'How to Add, Edit, or Delete a Customer in Swarnix',
    body: `In short: This is where you keep your customer list — their contact details and a tier (Regular, VIP, or VVIP) that controls what they can see and use.

Who can do this: Owners, Admins, and team members with Read & Write access can add, edit, and delete customers. Team members with Read Only access can view the customer list and search it, but won't see the Add/Edit/Delete buttons.

Before you start: Have the customer's name and WhatsApp number ready. Tier assignment only appears as a field if your store is on the Professional plan or above.

Steps — adding a customer:
1. Go to the Customers tab from the top menu.
2. Tap the gold "Add Customer" button.
3. Type in their Full Name (required).
4. If your plan supports tiers, pick a Customer Tier: Regular, VIP, or VVIP. New customers default to Regular if you don't change it.
5. Pick the country code (defaults to +91 India) and type their WhatsApp Number (required).
6. Optionally fill in Email and City.
7. Optionally add Notes — handy for noting preferred designs, anniversaries, or anything special about them.
8. Tap Save — you'll see a confirmation and they're added to your list.

Steps — editing a customer:
1. On the Customers tab, find the customer in the list.
2. Tap the pencil/edit icon next to their name.
3. Change whatever needs updating — name, tier, phone, email, city, or notes.
4. Tap "Update Customer" to save.

Steps — deleting a customer:
1. Find the customer in the list.
2. Tap the trash/delete icon next to their name.
3. Confirm when asked: "Remove this customer? This cannot be undone."
4. Once confirmed, they're permanently removed from your list.

Good to know:
- There's no limit on how many customers you can add.
- Deleting a customer is permanent — there's no soft-delete or recovery option.
- You can search your customer list by name or WhatsApp number using the search box at the top of the page.
- Customer tiers only show up as an option if your store is on the Professional plan or Enterprise plan.

Common questions:
- What does assigning a tier actually do? It controls which products this customer can see (based on each product's "Visible To" setting) and whether they're allowed to use the selfie virtual try-on feature.
- Can I change a customer's tier later? Yes, anytime — open Edit on their record, change the tier, and save.
- Why don't I see a Tier option when adding a customer? Tiers are a feature available from the Professional plan upward.
- Why can't my staff member add or remove customers? Only Read & Write access (or Admin/Owner) can add, edit, or delete.
- If I delete a customer, can I undo it? No — deletion is permanent and immediate.

If something goes wrong:
- Can't find a customer in the list — try the search box at the top (searches by name or WhatsApp number).
- Tier field missing on the form — this means your store's current plan doesn't include customer tiers.
- Delete failed with an error — try again; check your internet connection.

Note: The selfie virtual try-on access level (which tiers are allowed to use it) is actually set on the My Profile & Plan page, not on individual customers — it's a single store-wide setting with three choices (VVIP customers only / VIP & VVIP customers / All customers), editable by Admins and Owners.`
  },
  {
    slug: 'analytics-conversations',
    title: 'How to View Analytics and Customer Conversation Summaries in Swarnix',
    body: `In short: This is where you see how your inventory and customers are shaping up with simple charts, plus AI-written summaries of what your customers have been chatting about with your WhatsApp AI agent.

Who can do this: Anyone logged in — Owners, Admins, and all team members (Read & Write and Read Only) can view Analytics. There's no write action here, just viewing.

Before you start: Nothing — you can start right away.

Steps:
1. Go to the Analytics tab from the top menu.
2. At the top, you'll see "Usage This Month" cards showing your Credits used, Products count, and (if your plan includes them) AI Model Calls and Virtual Try-Ons used, each against your plan's limit.
3. Scroll down to see your Inventory Breakdown charts — Items by Category, Stock Status (in stock vs sold out), By Material, Price Distribution, and Metal Purity Breakdown. These are available on every plan.
4. If your store is on the Professional plan, Enterprise plan, or still on Trial, you'll also see: a Customer Tiers chart, a 6-month Credit Usage Trend, an AI Model Usage box, and a Top Categories chart.
5. Scroll further to Customer Chats — a list of customers grouped by their WhatsApp conversations, with message counts and how recently they messaged.
6. To see an AI-written wrap-up of a single customer's chats, tap "Generate AI Summary" next to their name in Customer Chats.
7. For a broader summary across many customers at once, scroll to the Conversation Summaries section, pick a time period (7, 14, or 30 days, or a custom number up to 30), and tap "Generate Summary".

Good to know:
- All the numbers and charts refresh automatically each time you open the page.
- The Conversation Summaries and Customer Chats sections are only available on the Professional plan, Enterprise plan, or while you're still on Trial — Starter plan stores will see an upgrade message instead.
- These conversation summaries currently only cover your WhatsApp AI agent chats — there's no separate summary feed for Web AI agent (website chatbot) conversations at the moment.
- There's no export-to-Excel or download button on this page yet.

Common questions:
- Can my staff see Analytics? Yes — anyone logged in can view this page.
- Why don't I see the Customer Chats or Conversation Summaries section? Your plan might be Starter — these sections need Professional, Enterprise, or Trial.
- Does this show my website chatbot conversations too, or just WhatsApp? Right now, all conversation data here is from WhatsApp only.
- How far back can I see conversation summaries? Up to 30 days at a time.
- Can I download these charts or summaries as a report? Not currently.

If something goes wrong:
- Summary generation seems to hang or fails — try again after a minute.
- Charts look empty — usually just means not enough products or chat history yet.
- Upgrade message instead of Customer Chats — that section needs Professional plan or above.`
  },
  {
    slug: 'manage-team',
    title: 'How to Manage Your Team in Swarnix',
    body: `In short: This is where you add staff or family members who need to log into Swarnix on your behalf, and decide exactly what each person is allowed to do.

Who can do this: Only the Owner (Google login) and team members with Admin access can add, edit, or remove team members. Read & Write and Read Only team members cannot manage the team at all.

Before you start: Decide on a username and a password (at least 6 characters) for the new person, and which access level fits what they should be allowed to do.

Steps — adding a team member:
1. Go to the Team tab from the top menu.
2. Tap the gold "+ Add User" button.
3. Type their Full Name.
4. Pick a Username for them — this gets saved in lowercase and cannot be changed later.
5. Set a Password for them — minimum 6 characters.
6. Choose their Role: Admin (full access — add/edit/delete products and customers, manage store settings, and manage other team members), Read & Write (can add and edit products, customers, and similar day-to-day records, but cannot manage store settings or other team members), or Read Only (can view everything but cannot add, edit, or delete anything).
7. Optionally add a Note.
8. Tap "Create User".

Tell the new team member their username and password — they'll use the Staff Login tab on the Swarnix login screen (separate from the Owner's Google sign-in) to log in.

Steps — editing a team member:
1. On the Team tab, find their entry, tap the pencil/edit icon.
2. You can change Full Name, Password (leave blank to keep current), Role, or Notes. Username cannot be changed.
3. Tap "Save Changes".

Steps — deactivating or removing a team member:
1. Tap the Active/Inactive toggle to temporarily block access without deleting their record.
2. Tap the trash/delete icon to remove them permanently — this deletes them immediately, with no confirmation prompt.

Good to know:
- There's no limit on how many team members you can add.
- A username can never be changed once set.
- Deleting a team member is instant — there's no "are you sure?" pop-up.
- Deactivating is the safer, reversible option if unsure.

Common questions:
- What can Read & Write do that Read Only can't? Read & Write can add and edit things like products and customers. Read Only can only look.
- Can my Admin staff add other staff members? Yes — Admin has the same team-management rights as the Owner.
- Can a Read & Write staff member promote themselves to Admin? No — only Owners or Admins can change roles.
- If I delete a team member, can I get their account back? No — deletion is immediate and permanent.
- Do actions taken by my staff show up as them or as me? There's no separate log showing which staff member did what — all actions happen under your store's account.

If something goes wrong:
- Forgot a team member's password — open Edit, type a new password, save.
- Accidentally deleted the wrong team member — no undo, recreate from scratch.
- Team member can't log in — check they're using Staff Login (not Owner Login), username is correct, and account isn't Inactive.`
  },
  {
    slug: 'add-offer',
    title: 'How to Add an Offer in Swarnix',
    body: `In short: This lets you post a seasonal deal or promotion — with a photo or video, details, and an expiry date — that your customers can see.

Who can do this: The Add/Edit/Delete buttons are visible to everyone who can open the Offers tab, but only the store Owner's account (and team members sharing that same store login) can actually save changes.

Before you start: Have your offer image or video ready (image up to 5 MB, video up to 50 MB), a short catchy title, and know how long the offer should run.

Steps:
1. Go to the Offers tab from the top menu.
2. Tap the "Add Offer" button.
3. Drag and drop your image or video into the upload box, or tap to browse.
4. Type your Offer title (required, up to 120 characters).
5. Optionally add Details describing the offer (up to 600 characters).
6. Optionally set Valid till — pick a date from the calendar. You can't pick a date in the past.
7. Tap Save — your offer is now posted.

Steps — editing or deleting an offer:
1. Find the offer card in your Offers list.
2. Tap the pencil icon to edit, change details, then tap "Save Changes".
3. Tap the trash icon to delete — confirm "Delete this offer?" when asked.

Good to know:
- Images must be under 5 MB, videos under 50 MB — both are accepted.
- There's no limit on how many offers you can have running at once.
- Once an offer's "Valid till" date passes, it doesn't disappear from your Offers list — it stays visible to you but gets a dimmed look and an "Expired" label.

Common questions:
- What happens to an offer once it expires? In your Offers list, it just turns faded with an "Expired" tag — it isn't deleted.
- Do I have to set an expiry date? No, it's optional.
- Can I upload a video instead of a photo? Yes, both are supported.
- Can my staff add offers too? The buttons show, but only your store's own login can actually save changes.
- Will customers stop seeing an expired offer automatically? That's the intent, but please confirm with your team — we couldn't fully verify this from the admin app alone.

If something goes wrong:
- File rejected on upload — check it's an image or video file under the size limit.
- Can't pick a past date — intentional, Swarnix only allows today or future dates.
- Offer not showing for customers — check the "Valid till" date hasn't passed.

Note: The admin screen marks expired offers visually but does not filter them out of the list it loads, and whether WhatsApp/website actually stop showing an expired offer to customers happens in a separate system outside this admin app.`
  },
  {
    slug: 'teach-ai-style',
    title: 'How to Teach AI Your Style in Swarnix',
    body: `In short: This lets you upload one of your real WhatsApp customer chats so the AI learns to reply the way you naturally do — your tone, your words, your style.

Who can do this: The app doesn't currently restrict this by team role, so any logged-in team member can reach this screen. The feature itself is only meant to be available on the Professional plan and Enterprise plan.

Before you start: Export a chat from WhatsApp first — you'll need the exported file, which comes as a .zip file, not a plain text file.

Steps — exporting a WhatsApp chat on Android:
1. Open WhatsApp and go into the customer chat you want to export.
2. Tap the three dots in the top right corner.
3. Tap More, then Export chat.
4. Tap Without Media.
5. Save or share the resulting .zip file somewhere you can access it.

Steps — exporting a WhatsApp chat on iPhone:
1. Open WhatsApp and go into the customer chat you want to export.
2. Tap the contact's name at the top of the chat.
3. Scroll down and tap Export Chat.
4. Tap Without Media.
5. Save the .zip file using the Files app, or share it to yourself.

Steps — uploading the chat to Swarnix:
1. Go to the "Teach AI Your Style" tab from the top menu.
2. Tap or drag your exported .zip file into the upload box. Only .zip files from WhatsApp's Export Chat feature work here.
3. Swarnix will ask you to confirm which name in the chat is you (the store).
4. Wait while Swarnix processes the chat and learns your style.
5. Once done, you'll see a confirmation showing your current style profile, last updated date, and how many conversations it learned from.
6. You can upload more chats anytime afterward to keep improving the style further.

Good to know:
- Only .zip files exported directly from WhatsApp's "Export Chat" feature work.
- There's no preview shown before you upload.
- There's currently no button to delete or reset a learned style — you can only add more chats to refine it.
- This is a newer feature intended for Professional and Enterprise plans.

Common questions:
- Does this change how the AI replies on WhatsApp, or also on my website chatbot? The intention is for it to apply to both, though it's worth testing both after uploading.
- Can I upload more than one chat? Yes — uploading more chats refines the style further, doesn't overwrite it.
- What if I picked the wrong "this is me" name by mistake? Re-upload and pick the correct name.
- Will my customer's personal details be exposed anywhere? The chat is only used to learn tone — handle the export file carefully.
- Can I see exactly what the AI learned before it goes live? No upfront preview — only after upload completes.

If something goes wrong:
- Upload won't accept your file — double check it's a .zip file from WhatsApp's Export Chat (Without Media).
- Wrong name detected as "you" — re-upload and pick the correct name.
- Upload seems stuck — check your internet connection and try again.

Note: We could not confirm that the learned style is actually being used yet by the WhatsApp AI agent or Web AI chatbot when generating replies — the upload and storage works, but whether it's applied to live replies lives in a separate backend system. There's also no permission check restricting this screen by team role, and no way to delete or reset a learned style.`
  },
  {
    slug: 'manage-faqs',
    title: 'How to Manage FAQs in Swarnix',
    body: `In short: This is where you keep a list of common questions and answers that your AI uses to respond automatically when customers ask things like store timings or your refund policy.

Who can do this: Only the Owner account can currently manage FAQs — team members logging in with a username and password (Admin, Read & Write, or Read Only) cannot access this page at all in the current setup.

Before you start: Nothing — Swarnix gives you 10 sample FAQs to start from.

Steps:
1. Go to the FAQ tab from the top menu.
2. The first time you open it, you'll see 10 sample FAQs already filled in, covering gold rate locking, making charges, hallmarking, buyback policy, certification, customisation, delivery time, payment options, returns/refunds, and jewellery care.
3. To edit a sample (or any) FAQ: tap the pencil icon, change the Question or Answer text, then tap Save.
4. To delete an FAQ: tap the trash icon, and confirm "Delete this FAQ?" when asked.
5. To add a brand-new FAQ: tap "Add FAQ", type your Question and Answer, then tap "Save FAQ".
6. Once you're happy with your list, save it — going forward, your customised FAQs are what your customers' questions get matched against.

Good to know:

Common questions:
- How does the AI actually use these FAQs? When a customer asks something on WhatsApp or your website that matches one of your FAQs, the AI answers using what you've written here.
- Can I delete all 10 sample FAQs and start completely fresh? Yes.
- Can my staff edit the FAQs? Not currently — only the Owner's own login can.
- Is there a category for organizing FAQs? No, it's just a simple list of questions and answers.
- Can I reorder my FAQs? Not at the moment — they appear in the order you created them.

If something goes wrong:
- Can't save an FAQ — make sure both Question and Answer boxes have text.
- Accidentally deleted an FAQ — there's a confirmation step before deleting, but once confirmed, it's gone.
- Staff member can't find the FAQ tab or it won't load — expected, since this page only works for the Owner's own login.

Who can do this: Only Owners and team members with Admin access can approve or reject reviews. Read & Write and Read Only team members do not have moderation rights here.

Before you start: Nothing — just open the page when you have new reviews to check.

Steps:
1. Tap your name/avatar in the top right corner.
2. Select "Review Moderation" from the dropdown (on mobile: hamburger menu → "Review Moderation").

4. For each review, tap "Approve" to let it go live on your storefront, or "Reject" to keep it hidden. Both happen instantly, no extra confirmation for single reviews.
5. Once you tap either, that review disappears from your pending list.
6. If you have many to clear at once, use "Approve All" or "Reject All" at the top — you'll be asked to confirm first since this affects everything in the list.

Good to know:
- This page only ever shows pending reviews — there's no tab to look back at reviews you already approved or rejected.
- Approving or rejecting a single review is immediate and has no undo.
- There's no badge or counter elsewhere in the app telling you how many reviews are waiting.
- Rejected reviews are simply marked rejected and stay hidden from your storefront.

- Where do these reviews come from? Customers post them directly on your website; they land here as pending until you decide.
- Can my Read & Write staff approve reviews for me? No — only Owner and Admin-level team members can.

- Can I undo a rejection if I change my mind? Not from this screen.
